node.title: L1 growing-cofactor decorated shift-pair compiler
node.statement: Two distinct members of one exact shell compile bijectively to an ordered record Omega=GABN with equal-degree disjoint split tails A,B, degree-e cofactors Q1,Q2, cross-coprimality from exactness, and nonzero residual R=AQ1-BQ2 of degree at most deg(A)-w-1; the ordered record count is exactly Z_a(U)(Z_a(U)-1). At scalar cofactor this is exactly the locator-Q shift-pair/second-moment ledger. For cofactor-primitive records gcd(Q1,Q2)=1 and e<=w, a fixed ordered pair (A,B) supports at most one cofactor decoration. A nonconstant common cofactor divides R and is coprime to ABN, so its domain roots lie in the common agreement core G. The support-pair census, common-cofactor payment, and e>w range remain open.
